svg.title: Depth-First Search
svg.desc: Depth-First Search. Follow one path as deep as it goes, then backtrack; a stack or recursion remembers where to resume, and finds cycles too. Step 1, Go deep first: From A, each call takes the first unvisited neighbour: A, B, D, G. G has nowhere new to go. Step 2, Back up and branch: Back up to B, resume at its next neighbour E, dive again. C took 4 edges: a path, not the shortest. Step 3, A back edge is a cycle: An edge back to a cell still on the stack means a cycle: here, a spreadsheet's circular reference. Step 4, Uses and limits: One O(V + E) walk finds paths, components, cycles and topological order, but not shortest paths.
